description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Dollar' within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functions to format and convert dollar values in financial calculations. It includes methods for currency formatting, dollar-decade conversions, and fractional representation, along with validations and error handling.

classes.name: Dollar
classes.description: Provides methods for formatting and converting dollar amounts in financial calculations.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a number or array of numbers into a dollar currency string.

methods.name: decimal
methods.description: Converts a fractional dollar value into a decimal number representing the dollar amount.

methods.name: fractional
methods.description: Converts a decimal dollar amount into its fractional dollar expression.
